question.:question/worked-solution:
Here, we have the product of two functions $u(x)=6\log_{6} x$ and $v(x)=\ln x.$ So, we apply the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & ={u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)+u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x) \\  & =(6\log_{6} x)^{′}\ln x+6\log_{6} x(\ln x)^{′} \\  & =(\frac{6}{x \ln{\left(6 \right)}})(\ln x)+(6\log_{6} x)(\frac{1}{x}) \\  & =\frac{6\log_{6} x}{x} + \frac{6\ln x}{x\ln 6}\end{aligned}
$$
